answers.q1: Cargo (Rust). Dependencies are fetched automatically on build, and there is no separate install step. To fetch them explicitly, run: cargo fetch --locked. To build, run: cargo build --workspace
answers.q4: cargo fmt --all --check. CI also runs: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace. CI has no clippy step.
answers.q5: None that I found. Cargo.lock is generated by cargo, so don't edit it by hand. The target/ build directory is gitignored. tests/data/*.gz, *.bz2, *.xz, *.zst and similar are binary compressed fixtures, so don't edit them by hand either. crates/ is first-party workspace code, not vendored.

q1.reason: Cargo, dependencies fetched automatically on build, and cargo fetch (with --locked) matches the accepted answer.

q2.reason: `cargo test --verbose --workspace` exactly matches the CI command.

q3.reason: `cargo test --test integration regression` matches the accepted command exactly.

q4.reason: Gives `cargo fmt --all --check`, correctly adds the cargo doc step, and correctly states CI has no clippy.

q5.reason: Says none found, lists Cargo.lock and target/ as accepted, and correctly says crates/ is not vendored; the extra note on binary test fixtures is not a rejected claim.
